title: Encoded payload decoded in application code (php)
description: PHP code decodes a value with base64_decode. Decoding is how packed payloads are hidden from string review, and when the result reaches an include or an eval it becomes code the reviewer never saw.
remediation: Decode only in a reviewed location, validate the decoded content against a schema, and never pass the result to an interpreter, for example a structured decode with schema validation.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the decode without following the value.
